item.title: 30,000 Merges a Day on One Side, Back to Hand-Coding on the Other
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: A company on V2EX banned AI coding after AI-written code caused a production incident, while Anthropic’s daily merged changes grew from 2,500 to over 30,000. The difference isn’t the AI, it’s the checkpoints. My call: within a year most software companies will be turned upside down, and the people who remain are the ones trusted to sign off.
